title: Standard
description: A published, versioned agreement on how things fit together. One file per standard, named 'NNN-slug.yaml' in its branch's folder: its id is <body prefix>/<branch path>/<NNN>, e.g. FSO/2.1/001. Not physics, not a product, not law, not a guarantee (docs/standards.md).

scope.description: What it covers, and what it doesn't.

refs.description: The standards it builds on, by id.

params.description: The values it fixes. A key ROW.column (S.length_max, 2.mass_max) makes a table: rows are classes or sizes, columns are figures.

value.description: A number, a range [at least, at most], or text.

unit.description: SI, as FSO/0.1/001 has them (m, kg, t, N, kN, W, V...); none for counts or text.

note.description: Where the number comes from; an invented one says what it's aimed at.

requires.description: What a conforming product must meet: its subject held to one of this standard's parameters.

subject.description: The product's figure: ship.length, module.mass, module.envelope...

param.description: A parameter's key, or a table's column (then per names the row the product declares).

per.description: The row: what the product declares (class, size, pad, power_class...).

text.description: For people: why, not only what.

licence.description: open, or a fee per conforming product (credits).

published.description: World time (s) it was published at its body's seat (0: from the start).
